title: Provider and role routing
description: /data/config/providers.yaml (design v3 §9.1). The shipped state maps every role to one local model; multi-model routing is off by default and turned on per role only with evidence that it helps.

default.description: The provider every unrouted role uses.

api_key_env.description: Names an environment variable rather than holding a secret, so this file stays safe to commit and to attach to a bug report.

timeout_seconds.description: Bounds one HTTP request to this provider. Omit for the 10-minute default. A profile whose budgets imply a longer request needs this raised: prefill of context_tokens plus decode of reserved_output_tokens, at the rates le models bench measured, is how long one call can take.

capabilities.description: DR-4 makes these a promise callers rely on: the engine refuses a provider that cannot call tools, and ChatStructured refuses rather than degrading. Declare only what this server actually does — `le models conformance` checks.

infill.description: llama.cpp needs a model with fill-in-the-middle tokens; not a property of the server.

embeddings.description: llama-server needs --embeddings; not a property of the server.

roles.description: Overrides the default per role. Empty is the shipped state.
